ability.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
ability.description: Shadowdancers are proficient with the club, crossbow (hand, light, or heavy), dagger (any type), dart, mace, morningstar, quarterstaff, rapier, sap, shortbow (normal and composite), and short sword. Shadowdancers are proficient with light armor but not with shields.

ability.name: Hide in Plain Sight
ability.description: Can use the Hide skill even while being observed, as long as within 10 ft. of a shadow other than own.

ability.name: Evasion
ability.description: On a successful Reflex save against an area attack, takes no damage instead of half.

ability.name: Uncanny Dodge
ability.description: Retains Dex bonus to AC even when flat-footed or struck by an invisible attacker.

ability.name: Shadow Illusion
ability.description: Can cast silent image as a spell-like ability once per day, using class level as caster level.

ability.name: Summon Shadow
ability.description: Summon a shadow companion from the Plane of Shadow. If destroyed, cannot be summoned for 30 days.

ability.name: Shadow Jump
ability.description: Teleport between shadows as a move action, up to a total distance per day that increases with level.

ability.name: Defensive Roll
ability.description: Once per day when reduced to 0 or fewer HP by damage, can attempt a Reflex save (DC = damage dealt) to take only half damage.

ability.name: Improved Uncanny Dodge
ability.description: Cannot be flanked except by a rogue 4+ levels higher.

ability.name: Shadow Jump
ability.description: Total shadow jump distance increases to 40 feet per day.

ability.name: Shadow Companion Growth
ability.description: Shadow companion gains +2 HD (and the requisite base attack and base save bonus increases).

ability.name: Slippery Mind
ability.description: If affected by an enchantment spell, can attempt a second saving throw 1 round later.

ability.name: Shadow Jump
ability.description: Total shadow jump distance increases to 80 feet per day.

ability.name: Shadow Companion Growth
ability.description: Shadow companion gains +2 HD (and the requisite base attack and base save bonus increases).

ability.name: Improved Evasion
ability.description: On a failed Reflex save against an area attack, takes half damage instead of full; no damage on success.

ability.name: Shadow Jump
ability.description: Total shadow jump distance increases to 160 feet per day.
